selection_rationale: cnd-2026-001 (verifier-assisted generate→validate→repair) best balances scientific importance (operational correctness/safety), feasibility within available compute/model budget, clear falsifiable primary outcome, and high venue relevance; critic review marked it 'pass' with concrete, addressable repairs.
unresolved_uncertainties: Oracle incompleteness: deterministic oracle may miss real semantic failure modes and require human spot-checks.
Emulator-to-hardware fidelity: emulated vendor images may not capture production device behavior across vendors.
Validator confounding and overfitting: validator/repair design may itself drive improvements and be overfit to the task set.
Provider/model drift and reproducibility: model-version or provider changes could affect results unless model identifiers are frozen and logged.
Operational scaling costs: latency and API-cost/latency trade-offs of repair loops at operational scale remain uncertain.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Precisely specify oracle coverage and include a human spot-check protocol for cases where the oracle and human judgment disagree.
Publish and preregister the full validator rule-set and the exact repair prompts used by the pipeline.
Include a sensitivity analysis plan that varies validator strictness and repair-prompt phrasing to measure robustness.
Log and freeze model identifier(s); record timestamps and cryptographic hashes to detect provider/model drift and support reproducibility.
Define and preregister explicit exclusions, retry-policy, and how technical vs. scientific failures will be handled and reported.
